response.sql: WITH per_site AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_mem, AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / p.proccpu) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_mem) AS avg_of_avg_memusagegb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: 'Memory-heavy runs using 60.8 GB as the cutoff' means memusagegb strictly greater than 60.8 (runs at exactly 60.8 are excluded).
Runs whose zoneref has no matching site are dropped (inner join). Sites with a NULL entrystat form their own group.
The GPU/CPU ratio is computed per run as procgpu/proccpu using floating-point division. Rows with NULL values, or with proccpu = 0 (which gives NULL in SQLite), are ignored by AVG.
The second-stage averages are unweighted means of the per-site averages. They are not weighted by the number of runs in each site.
